hypothesis: CLN being active restores centering behavior (mean reversion) toward baseline
interpretation: CLN active STRONGLY restored mean reversion: -0.1175 (147.7% of GT on this test split), massively better than 167b (11.8%). In fact 167d OVER-reverts (>100% of GT) on average. Note: baseline 50% used a different methodology (full test split). The key comparison is 167d vs 167b using the same 50-window methodology: 167b mean_reversion_ratio=11.8%, 167d=147.7%, a 12.5x improvement. CLN being active is unambiguously the driver of centering recovery. L@eps slightly opposes reversion (mean +0.005 on slopes, 16/25 cells) but the effect is small relative to base_slope magnitude.
